'''Rossiker''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] of the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed at the [[Drall Library]] near Capitol Square where he met the Barsen'thor who was in search for the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]] and [[Guardian Hold One]]. He assisted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Rift Alliance]] in triangulating the bunker's position with communication points around the Square.<ref name="TOR" />
